section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: 6 The volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population did not reveal and definite trend over the period 1967—74. It was only during 1971-73 that accidental deaths per one lakh of population declined in comparison to earlier four years. During 1974, the volume of accidental deaths increased. From 18.5 accidental deaths per one lakh of population in 1973, it went up to 18.9 per one lakh of population in 1974. The details regarding the number of accidental deaths yearwise and the volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population for the period 1967—74 are set forth in Table II.
